facility.name: Moody Early Childhood Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Accredited,Get Well Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Field Trips

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record: At time of inspection, one caregivers file was observed to have pre-service training. FIle was missing training certificates for annual training that could not be located during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Original Training Certification Card or Letter in each Employee's personnel record (26 TAC §746.1329(a))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation was unable to tell me how they will make sure that staff create an incident/ illness report any other non-routine situation that placed, or may have placed, a child at risk for injury or harm, such as forgetting a child in a center vehicle or not preventing a child from wandering away from the child-care center unsupervised outside of firing staff members
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The operation was not able to inform me on how their staff will Demonstrate competency, good judgment, and self-control in the presence of children and when performing assigned responsibilities; outside of firing its staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: The operation was not able to inform me on how they will ensure that staff understand that there must be no harsh, cruel, or unusual treatment of any child. I was just informed that they will fire staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Notify Immediately about Allegation of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: The operation was not able to inform me on how they will ensure that staff understand to notify the parents of a child immediately if there is an allegation that the child has been abused, neglected, or exploited, as defined in Texas Family Code ?261.001, while in care outside of firing its staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Notify Immediately about Allegation of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.307(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: The operation was not able to inform me on how they will ensure that no child is abused, neglected, or exploited while in the care of the center; and   outside of firing its staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Toddler rooms had a plastic sink in the kitchen area broken. (This was corrected when the caregiver threw the sink away). A mat in the library was ripped. (This was corrected when a caregiver threw the mat away). In a Pre-K room there were electrical cords hanging off of the counter. (This was corrected when a staff and a caregiver cleaned up the area and ensured the cords were not hanging.) In a Pre-K room an outlet was observed uncovered. (This was corrected when the outlet was covered).     In a toddler room the carpet to a small slide was fraying at the end.A baseboard in the Pre-K Room was pealing away from the wall. A changing table was observed cracked on the edge and along the side.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During the walk through a two year old child who is medically diagnosed with Cerebral Palsy was strapped inside of a chair because the child was fighting with other children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Eight infants were missing an updated infant care sheet
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the neck.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, the caregiver used inappropriate discipline with a child in care. The caregiver actions were concerning when it appeared that they were targeting the child's every action.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver was observed yelling at a child via video.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information obtained during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when the caregiver did not tell the truth about the incident which led to the caregiver pulling a child's arm, which resulted in the child needing medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver was observed grabbing a child's right arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on external documentation, an incident report was not completed by the operation within the required timeframe. The incident report was completed 9 days later.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation that prohibited punishment of grabbing a child was used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: One file did was missing the child s ability to swim without assistance documentation required by the new admission forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was no drills documentation since December 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: There is no documentation that the monthly check were done for the month of January 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Four out of 10 files reviewed did not have the admission date on the form. This was corrected at inspection when the dates were added to the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There is no documentation that the monthly check were done for the month of January 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: One file  reviewed is missing the special needs documentation required by the new admission forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Three out of ten files did not have the complete admission form paperwork.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There is no documentation that the monthly check were done for the month of January 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regarding inappropriate relationship with minor: The operation has failed to complete the Pre-Employment affidavit on caregivers with hire date 09/18/2023 and 10/04/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regarding inappropriate relationship with minor (26 TAC §HRC 42.0563 - Employment affidavit regar)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a citation for prohibited punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There was no drills documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the owl and turtle classroom the paint was peeling on the walls. A photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
